And with Ukraine's Independence Day tomorrow, Kyiv's bracing for Russia to answer with something big.

For your science hit: astronomers using the James Webb telescope found that the universe's earliest galaxies are hiding a huge population of small, faint stars nobody had counted.

Fold those in, and some of those young galaxies may be three to four times more massive than we thought — which quietly reshapes the story of how fast the first galaxies grew up.

Word of the day: flag — in climbing, sticking a leg out to the side as a counterweight so your body doesn't swing off the wall like a door on a hinge; pure balance, no extra hold needed.

And an AI tip worth stealing: when you write a long prompt, put your single most important instruction right at the top and repeat it at the very bottom — models pay the most attention to the start and the end, and anything buried in the middle tends to get lost.
